scope: Readonly follow-up on decoder finite-value and format handling. No new defect confirmed and no code changes.

source_facts.fact: parseWAV rejects every non-PCM format tag and every non-16 bit depth before decode. IEEE float NaN/Inf samples cannot enter through a supported format.
Both public readers share decodeWAV; every decoded sample is an int16 divided by32768, so supported decoded sample values are finite and bounded. Partial frames are rejected.
Existing rejection controls include float format tag, wrong bit depth, zero rate, missing fmt/data and truncated data.
